extDescription.message: Built-in features of Mantis Browser: new tab, settings, forget a site, one-click updates, WireGuard VPN with routing, encrypted DNS, settings sync, sensitive sites kept out of history, opening a site in another browser, copying without diacritics, saving images as PNG/JPG, editing a page before saving it as PDF.

update_notifyInstallable.message: It includes security fixes. Click and Mantis will download, verify and run the installer – your bookmarks and passwords stay.

update_notifyDownload.message: It includes security fixes. Click to download – just run the installer over your current version; your bookmarks and passwords stay.

update_lwMessage.message: Mantis is built from $1. Run scripts/check-update.sh --apply, build and publish-installer.sh.

update_errorTitle.message: The update could not be installed

update_errorMessage.message: $1. You can download the installer manually from moneyas.cz/mantis.

err_dohUri.message: The DNS server address must start with https://

err_storeUpdates.message: The Microsoft Store version is updated by the Store

err_installerFolder.message: The installer is not in the downloads folder

err_installerHash.message: The installer checksum does not match – download it manually from moneyas.cz/mantis

err_webAddressOnly.message: Only web addresses can be opened in another browser

forget_doneMessage.message: The site's history, cookies, cache and data are deleted. Close any open tabs of this site, otherwise it will store data again.

sensitive_menu.message: Don't save this site in history

sensitive_addedTitle.message: $1 is no longer saved in history

sensitive_addedMessage.message: The site's existing history is deleted. To change this: Mantis Settings → Sensitive sites.

doh_reason_blocked.message: the network doesn't want it (Pi-hole, company network) – using the network's DNS

other_noBrowser.message: No other installed browser was found

other_errorTitle.message: The site could not be opened in another browser

other_reason_netflix.message: Netflix can't play videos in Mantis

other_notifyMessage.message: Click to open the site in $1. The same button is on the right of the address bar.

other_popupReason.message: Netflix can't play videos in Mantis – it requires a DRM signature (Widevine VMP) that only official browsers such as Firefox, Chrome or Edge have.

other_popupNone.message: No other installed browser was found.

vpn_lostBlocked.message: Traffic that should go through the VPN is blocked until the VPN reconnects or you turn it off.

vpn_lostDirect.message: The browser now connects to the internet directly.

vpnErr_invalidProfile.message: The profile is not a valid WireGuard configuration (missing $1); only WireGuard is supported.

vpnErr_profileDecrypt.message: The VPN profile can't be decrypted (a different user or computer?) – add it again.

vpnErr_profileEncrypt.message: The VPN profile could not be encrypted: $1

vpnErr_noWireproxy.message: wireproxy.exe is missing next to mantis-vpn.exe.

vpnErr_wireproxyFailed.message: wireproxy failed to start – check the profile.

vpn_noHost.message: The VPN helper is not installed.

vpn_noHostHint.message: In the browser's folder open vpn, right-click register-vpn.ps1 → Run with PowerShell and restart the browser.

vpn_unblockHint.message: The VPN is on, so traffic is blocked (kill switch).

vpn_profileIntro.message: Add a WireGuard profile – a .conf file from your VPN server or provider (PiVPN, Mullvad, Proton VPN, your own server…).

vpn_onlyWireguard.message: Only WireGuard is supported. OpenVPN, IKEv2 and other protocols are not implemented yet.

vpn_confPlaceholder.message:
Paste the contents of the .conf file or drop the file here

[Interface]
PrivateKey = …

[Peer]
Endpoint = …

vpn_storedHint.message: The profile is stored encrypted on this computer only (%LOCALAPPDATA%\mantis\vpn), not in the browser – only your Windows account can decrypt it.

vpn_stateDirect.message: The browser connects to the internet directly.

vpn_stateBlocked.message: The VPN is not running – traffic that should go through it is blocked (kill switch). Mantis tries to restart it every minute; turn off the VPN to let traffic go directly.

vpn_routedAll.message: Browser traffic goes through the VPN.

vpn_routedOnly.message: Only selected sites and containers go through the VPN, the rest goes directly.

vpn_routedExcept.message: Everything except the selected sites and containers goes through the VPN.

vpn_stateNoResponse.message: The tunnel isn't responding yet – check your internet connection and the VPN server.

vpn_fileTooBig.message: The file is too large – is it really a WireGuard configuration?

vpn_isOpenVpn.message: This is an OpenVPN configuration. Mantis Browser supports only WireGuard for now.

vpn_notWireguard.message: This doesn't look like a WireGuard configuration ([Interface], PrivateKey, [Peer] or Endpoint is missing).

vpn_confirmRemove.message: Remove the VPN profile from this computer?

newtab_search.message: Search the web or enter an address

newtab_updateInstall.message: Mantis Browser $1 is available (you have $2) – install

newtab_updateDownload.message: Mantis Browser $1 is available (you have $2) – download

newtab_installerRunning.message: The installer is running – finish the installation in its window

welcome_intro.message: A fast and private browser. Nothing below is required – you'll find everything later in Mantis Settings too (the gear on the new tab).

welcome_adblockHint.message: uBlock Origin is part of the browser (just like in LibreWolf, which Mantis is based on). Tracking protection is on, telemetry is off.

welcome_dohHint.message: Your internet provider and foreign networks (café, hotel) won't see which sites you open. DNS queries then go to Quad9 (can be changed in settings). At home with Pi-hole or on a company network, the network's DNS stays in use.

welcome_addonsHint.message: “Add” opens the extension's page on addons.mozilla.org, where you confirm the installation. You can remove extensions at any time in ☰ → Add-ons and themes.

welcome_addon_bitwarden_text.message: Password manager – passwords in an encrypted vault, synced across devices.

welcome_addon_containers_text.message: Tab containers – separate logins (e.g. two Google accounts) and isolated sites.

welcome_addon_czechDictionary_text.message: Czech spell checking when typing on the web.

welcome_addon_ttvLolPro_warn.message: Stream segment lists go through a third-party proxy – it sees which channel you watch and your IP address.

settings_pipHint.message: When you switch from a video to another tab, the video pops out into a small window.

settings_autoplayHint.message: Exceptions for individual sites: the icon on the left of the address bar.

settings_smoothScrollHint.message: Softer mouse wheel scrolling, similar to Chrome and Edge.

settings_webglHint.message: Needed by maps, 3D sites and some games. Turning it off reduces the attack surface through the graphics driver and makes it harder for sites to recognize your computer by its graphics card. Applies to newly opened pages.

settings_backgroundHint.message: A subtle gradient in the logo's colour.

settings_forgetHint.message: Deletes the site's history, cookies, cache, stored data and permissions (including subdomains). Quicker: right-click the page or tab → Forget site.

settings_forgetInvalid.message: Enter a site address, e.g. example.com.

settings_forgetConfirm.message: Forget $1? Its history, cookies, cache and data will be deleted.

settings_otherOpenInHint.message: For sites that don't work in Mantis – such as Netflix, which requires a DRM signature (Widevine VMP) that only official browsers have. You can open any site in another browser by right-clicking the page, tab or link.

settings_otherSites.message: Sites with an address bar button

settings_otherSitesHint.message: One per line, subdomains included. On these sites a button for opening them in another browser appears in the address bar.

settings_otherNotify.message: Notify when such a site is opened

settings_otherNotifyHint.message: Once per Mantis start; clicking the notification opens the site in another browser.

settings_dohModeHint.message: Your internet provider and the network (café, hotel) won't see which sites you open. Off by default. Automatic turns it on only on networks that allow it – at home with Pi-hole or on a company network, the network's DNS stays in use. With the VPN on, DNS goes through the tunnel.

settings_dohProviderHint.message: Quad9 also blocks malware sites; Mullvad with blocking blocks ads as well.

settings_sensitiveEnabled.message: Don't save sensitive sites in history

settings_sensitiveEnabledHint.message: After a visit, the page is immediately removed from history, address bar suggestions and recently closed tabs. To add a site quickly: right-click the page or tab → Don't save site in history.

settings_sensitiveAdultHint.message: About 13,000 known sites and addresses with words like porn, xxx, hentai.

settings_sensitiveCustomHint.message: One per line, e.g. example.com – subdomains included.

settings_sensitiveExceptionsHint.message: Sites that are always saved in history (e.g. when the list marks them by mistake).

settings_sensitiveCleanHint.message: Removes sensitive pages visited earlier from history.

settings_sensitiveCleanConfirm.message: Go through the whole history and remove sensitive pages from it?

settings_sensitiveNote.message: Note: open tabs are restored after a restart including their Back button history, and cookies (logins) are still saved. For full privacy use a private window or right-click → Forget site.

settings_recommendedHint.message: Bitwarden, tab containers, Czech dictionary, Consent-O-Matic and TTV LOL PRO – nothing installs by itself, the page offers them to add with one click.

settings_updatesMantisHint.message: Checks moneyas.cz once a day; when a new version is out, it shows a notification and a download link on the new tab.

settings_updatesLibreWolf.message: Watch for new LibreWolf versions too

settings_updatesLibreWolfHint.message: For whoever builds Mantis: notifies that a new build is needed.

settings_updateInstallable.message: New version $1 is available. “Install” downloads it, verifies it and runs the installer.

settings_updateDownload.message: New version $1 is available – download it and install it over the current one.

settings_updateStore.message: Installed from the Microsoft Store – the Store installs new versions automatically.

settings_installerRunning.message: The installer is running – finish the installation in its window (Mantis will close during it).

settings_vpnHint.message: Profile, on/off and status – the same as the shield button in the bottom toolbar.

settings_killSwitchHint.message: When the VPN is on and the connection drops (or hasn't connected yet after the browser starts), traffic that should go through the VPN is blocked instead of going directly. Mantis tries to restore the VPN every minute; turn off the VPN to let traffic go directly.

settings_routingHint.message: Applies to the browser only – the rest of the computer doesn't use the VPN.

settings_routingSitesHint.message: One per line: a domain (subdomains included, e.g. moneyas.cz), an IP address or a range (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 for a home network).

settings_routingContainersHint.message: All tabs in a checked container are treated like the selected sites.

settings_routingNoContainers.message: No containers – create them with the containers button in the bottom toolbar.

settings_syncHint.message: Through your Firefox account (Settings → Sync, turn on Add-ons) across all your computers: switches, encrypted DNS and VPN routing. Sensitive sites and the VPN profile are not synced – they stay on this computer only.

tools_unaccentFailed.message: The text could not be copied

tools_imageNotFound.message: There is no image at this spot

tools_imageFailed.message: The image could not be saved

tools_imageBlob.message: The site creates the image inside the page – try right-click → Save Image As…, or a screenshot (Ctrl+Shift+S).

tools_printEditUnavailable.message: This page can't be edited (browser pages and addons.mozilla.org)

tools_readerUnavailable.message: Reader view isn't available for this page

printEdit_hint.message: Click the parts of the page you don't want in the PDF

settings_toolUnaccentHint.message: Right-click selected text → Copy without diacritics, or press Ctrl+Shift+U (change it in ☰ → Add-ons and themes → gear → Manage Extension Shortcuts). “Příliš žluťoučký” is pasted as “Prilis zlutoucky”.

settings_toolSaveImageHint.message: Right-click an image → Save image as PNG / JPG. Converts WebP and AVIF too, and finds the image even where the site hides it under another layer or in a background.

settings_toolPrintEditHint.message: Right-click the page → Edit and save as PDF…: click to remove ads, bars and other parts of the page, then save it as a PDF (scale and margins are set in the print dialog).

welcome_addon_consentOMatic_text.message: Rejects cookie banners for you (allows only necessary cookies) instead of just hiding them. Open source from Aarhus University; downloads site rules from GitHub.

tools_imageUnsupported.message: the image format could not be read
